messages:
mira: opened a PR that tightens the SA scopes and moves a few onprem env secrets to a namespaced vault path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-platform/pull/4782 — tagging sec/infra because this touches VPC peering and egress rules. asking for quick review and merge window advice :eyes:

jamal: looking now. quick question — are we rotating any KMS keys as part of this change or just narrowing the SA? can you paste the new vault path?

mira: just narrowing SA for now + moving secret paths. vault path set to `/vault/data/apps/inference` and policies limited to that prefix. example snippet in PR:```env
VAULT_SECRET_PATH=/vault/data/apps/inference
```

security-bot: automated-scan: 1 HIGH - SA token scope includes `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs` on proj-wide SA. see scanner-id: S-2026-09. Recommend remove actAs and use short-lived tokens. :robot_face:

mira: good catch. will remove actAs. plan: replace long-lived SA usage with short-lived tokens via our token-broker and update rollout docs. doing a patch now. :wrench:

carol: infra note — because this changes how services reach Vault/KMS from onprem, we need an egress rule to allow 172.31.0.0/16 -> vault.redwood-internal:443 and kms.redwood-internal:443, and update the VPC peering ACL. when are you planning to canary?

mira: planning a canary on dedicated cluster us-west2, 5% traffic for 2h, fallback to previous deployment on any error. target window: Monday 22:00 UTC. is that ok for infra ops?

carol: ok, I can schedule it. I'll also open firewall task and add a quick test to smoke the vault+kms endpoints. creating task TICKET-3421 and will attach steps.

jamal: security side: lgtm for scope narrowing once actAs removed and token lifetime <= 1h enforced. CI must pass and security-bot should re-scan. post-merge: trigger a KMS key rotation doc for onprem secrets (low-impact rotation window). :thumbsup:

mira: updated PR to remove actAs and switch to token-broker flow. CI kicked off. added instructions for onprem ops in the PR description.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: CI ✅, scan pending. canary schedule set for 2498920000 (Mon 22:00 UTC).

security-bot: re-scan: no HIGH findings. info: recommend audit log for vault read ops enabled for the inference namespace.

jamal: approving once CI green — please add a follow-up to verify audit logs after canary completes.

mira: will merge after green CI and no regressions in canary. thanks all for quick checks :heart:
